episodes.title: The Order
episodes.link: Series opening. Lumine witnesses Fatui giving Childe the order to bring her in.
beats: Northland Bank at night. A Fatui Agent hands Childe a sealed scroll.
Childe breaks the seal, reads it. His expression darkens.
He drops the scroll into a candle flame.
Lumine watches from the shadows — she saw everything.
Childe senses her presence and turns. The Agent turns too.
Childe steps between Lumine and the Agent.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent stares at Childe, waiting. Cold silence.
cliffhanger.line: Prove she matters less than your orders.

episodes.title: Leave Liyue
episodes.link: After EP1 Childe is caught between orders and his own choice. He tries to push Lumine away — harshly.
beats: Rain-soaked street in Liyue Harbor.
Lumine follows Childe. He stops abruptly.
She demands answers. He tells her to leave the city today.
She refuses.
A Fatui watcher is spotted on the rooftop above.
Childe draws his weapon — aimed at Lumine.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Then look me in the eye when you say it.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe's blade points at Lumine. Rooftop watcher still watching.

episodes.title: Fake Fight
episodes.link: Childe stages a fake attack on Lumine to fool the Fatui — without telling her.
beats: Narrow street. Childe strikes first — fast and deliberate.
Lumine blocks. She doesn't know if it's real.
Childe whispers one word: 'Play along.'
Lumine fights back harder — genuinely angry.
The Fatui watcher on the rooftop takes aim at Lumine.
Childe sees the rifle. He steps into the shot.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe drops to one knee. His shoulder is bleeding.

episodes.title: Not Your Mission
episodes.link: Lumine hides the wounded Childe. She bandages him — and finally forces out the truth.
beats: Empty teahouse after closing. Lumine wraps Childe's shoulder.
He tries to make light of it. She pulls the bandage tighter.
Childe admits: the order was always about her.
Lumine pulls her hands away. Silence.
The Fatui Agent enters through the door.
Childe stands up and puts himself between them.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Then why do you keep lying?

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: Because the truth wouldn't stop you.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent looks at Childe's bandaged shoulder. His eyes say everything.

episodes.title: The Betrayal
episodes.link: To save Lumine, Childe pretends to hand her over — without warning her.
beats: Childe slowly steps back from Lumine, toward the Agent.
The Agent orders him to bring her closer.
Lumine stares at Childe — pure hatred.
Childe grips her wrist. She almost breaks free.
He leans close and whispers in her ear.
The Agent steps forward. Childe meets his eyes and blinks.

cliffhanger.scene: Lumine's fist connects with the Agent. Childe smiles.

episodes.title: Run With Me
episodes.link: They escape together — but Lumine is furious that Childe made the call without her again.
beats: Night port. Lumine and Childe sprint through the docks. Fatui behind them.
Childe is running on the wounded shoulder. She notices.
She grabs his arm to help him. She's still angry.
They duck into the shadow of the Golden House entrance.
Lumine demands he stop deciding things for her.
Childe says without the setup she wouldn't have played along.
The Golden House doors open from inside.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: I'm not a piece on your board.

cliffhanger.scene: Inside the Golden House, Fatui are already waiting.
cliffhanger.line: How romantic. You both came yourselves.

episodes.title: Golden House Again
episodes.link: Fatui trap them in the Golden House and order Childe to prove loyalty by fighting Lumine for real.
beats: Inside the Golden House. Childe and Lumine face each other across the chamber floor.
The Agent orders Childe to prove his loyalty.
Childe raises his weapon.
Lumine holds his gaze. No fear.
Combat begins. Childe strikes near her — not at her.
Lumine notices the pattern. Behind her a Fatui soldier charges.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: Don't you dare go easy on me.

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: I'm not going easy on you.

cliffhanger.scene: Childe's blade flies past Lumine — and pins the charging Fatui soldier to the wall.
cliffhanger.line: You were protecting me the whole time?

episodes.title: Choose Her
episodes.link: The Fatui realize Childe has chosen Lumine over Snezhnaya. He is declared a traitor.
beats: Fatui soldiers fan out around them.
Childe is breathing hard but smiling.
The Agent gives him a final ultimatum.
Lumine tells Childe not to do anything reckless.
Childe tears the Fatui insignia from his coat.
The Agent's expression turns to ice. Fatui charge.
Childe and Lumine fight side by side for the first time.

cliffhanger.scene: The Agent retreats toward the exit, calm.
cliffhanger.line: The port is already sealed. She can't leave.

episodes.title: Don't Follow
episodes.link: Childe draws the Fatui off alone so Lumine can reach the ships.
beats: Dawn. Liyue Harbor port.
Lumine spots Fatui soldiers blocking every ship.
Childe shows her a shortcut through the warehouse — a clear path to the water.
She understands: he isn't coming with her.
He smiles and pulls the warehouse door closed between them.
She hears the clash of battle on the other side.
She starts toward the ships.
She stops. She turns back.

key_lines.speaker: Childe
key_lines.line: It's very much my style though.

cliffhanger.scene: Lumine re-enters through the warehouse. Childe is on his knees before a ring of Fatui soldiers.

loops: whether Childe can still fight
how many Fatui soldiers remain

episodes.title: Come Back Without Orders
episodes.link: Lumine returns and saves Childe herself. The season ends on an open promise.
beats: Lumine charges into the Fatui circle.
Childe tries to push himself upright.
She steps in front of him.
The Agent arrives. He surveys the scene — too many witnesses at the open port.
He orders the Fatui to fall back.
The soldiers leave. The port goes silent.
Childe and Lumine stand alone on the empty docks.
He reaches into his coat and returns something she dropped — her travel pouch.
He turns to leave first.

key_lines.speaker: Lumine
key_lines.line: You were supposed to be the enemy.

cliffhanger.scene: SEASON CLIFF. Childe steps back. One last look over his shoulder.
cliffhanger.line: Next time I'll come back without orders.

episode_summaries.summary: Childe steps back from Lumine toward the Fatui Agent, and the Agent orders him to bring her closer — Lumine believes she's being handed over for real. He grips her wrist as she fights him, then leans in and whispers the real plan in her ear: 'When I blink — hit him.' As the Agent steps forward to take her, Childe meets his eyes and blinks.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Lumine's fist connects with the Agent — Childe smiles: 'Now I believe you.'
episode_summaries.notes: All 6 clips stayed in the same Liyue teahouse from EP4 (no location change) — first pass wrongly moved scenes 3-6 to an invented market street to accommodate a diegetic 'FREE PRIMOGEMS' banner request; re-rendered those 4 scenes back into the teahouse, with the banner glimpsed through the open door/window instead. Also re-confirmed and fixed a Childe costume-drift bug (invented armor+cape+pendant under dramatic close-shot framing) during the same fix. See production_rules for both lessons.

episode_summaries.summary: Teaser hook: Lumine's face half-hidden in shadow, watching something unseen. Northland Bank interior at night — Agent hands Childe a sealed scroll. Childe reads it, expression darkens, drops it into candle flame. Lumine witnesses from alcove shadows. Agent speaks the order aloud. Lumine steps partially out: 'This is about me?' Childe puts himself between them: 'You shouldn't have come here.' Lumine: 'Too late.'
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Agent cold and measured: 'Prove she matters less than your orders.'
episode_summaries.notes: 8 clips: 3 I2V action (clips 1-3, 5+7+5s) + 5 Avatar dialogue (clips 4-8, trimmed to TTS). Chatterbox voice clone. Narrator VO overlay on clips 1-3.

episode_summaries.summary: Opening: Lumine calls out to Childe's retreating figure in the rain — raw desperation. Wide establishing shot: both figures on rain-soaked Liyue lane, rooftop watcher silhouette spotted. Childe turns and confronts. He orders her to leave today. She refuses and demands he look her in the eye. He draws his hydro blade — aimed at her.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Childe's blade extended toward Lumine. He whispers: 'I'm sorry. They're watching.'

episode_summaries.summary: Lumine bandages Childe's wound in the empty teahouse after closing. He deflects with jokes; she presses until he admits the order was always about her. She pulls away in silence — right as the Fatui Agent walks in and sees the bandage.

episode_summaries.notes: First episode on the Kling I2V voice_ids pipeline (retired Avatar+Chatterbox from EP1-3). 6 clips, macro movement allowed (user override). Added: diegetic in-scene promo poster (scenes 4-5), pop-up promo banner (top, 80px margin, fade in/out ~5.5s after clip 1), episode title strip (restored, matches EP1-3 convention). Scene 6 required a re-render: a multi_prompt voice-tag misattribution + missing eye-color in Childe's bible descriptor caused character identity drift/confusion — fixed and documented in production_rules.

episode_summaries.summary: Lumine and Childe sprint down the night docks with Fatui pursuers behind them, Childe favoring his wounded shoulder. They reach the Golden House and press against its closed doors, catching their breath, before Lumine turns on him: he chose for her again, without asking. He says he chose a chance. She insists she's not a piece on his board; he answers quietly that she's not, not to him. The doors behind them creak open from the inside.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: The Fatui Agent steps out of the now-open Golden House doors, cold and amused: 'How romantic. You both came yourselves.'
episode_summaries.notes: Major continuity rework mid-production: an attempt to stage the accusation exchange (originally scenes 4-5) as separate independently-generated scenes at a 'side wall' location broke spatially (characters appeared to teleport, then swap left/right positions across cuts) - fixed by merging the whole exchange into ONE multi_prompt I2V clip (13s, 4 shots) from a single start frame instead, keeping Lumine fixed LEFT / Childe fixed RIGHT throughout. Also split the reveal into two scenes: a silent Agent-reveal (no voice_ids, introduced via Kling `elements` since the Agent wasn't in the start frame) followed by his cliffhanger line. A pursuit scene (running toward the Golden House) also needed 3 iterations to get right: characters must run AWAY from camera toward their actual destination door (not toward camera with the door as incidental backdrop), and that destination door must be generated as a direct NB2-edit descendant of the door asset used in the arrival scene, not an independently-generated 'similar' building, or the two doors visibly don't match on the cut. See rules/formats/serial-drama.md's location-bg-ref-reuse and blocking-continuity burn notes (2026-07-14) for the full writeup. Also user-requested pop-up 'GAIN FREE PRIMOGEMS' banner overlay on scenes 1-2 (top-anchored, post-production, not diegetic).

episode_summaries.summary: Inside the Golden House, the Fatui Agent orders Childe to defeat Lumine for real to prove his loyalty. Childe raises his weapon and combat begins, but every strike lands near her, never on her. Lumine catches the pattern and questions him mid-fight. Behind her, a Fatui soldier charges — Childe's blade flies past her and pins the soldier to the wall instead.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Lumine, realizing: 'You were protecting me the whole time?'
episode_summaries.notes: Scene 1's start frame briefly rendered a duplicate background Lumine (two instances instead of one); a reproducibility test with byte-identical prompt+refs got a correct single-instance result on retry, confirming this was generation-to-generation randomness, not a deterministic prompt bug. Introduced this series' on-screen title card (type `text`): 'EPISODE 7 / Golden House Again' drawtext overlay (Montserrat-Black, top of frame, scene 1 only, t=0-3s), previewed via a standalone ffmpeg frame before committing. User confirmed 2026-07-22 this is now the standing convention for every future episode of this series, not a one-off — see updated `production_rules` above (supersedes the old 'no title card' rule).

episode_summaries.summary: The Fatui Agent forces Childe to choose between Snezhnaya and Lumine. Lumine warns him not to sacrifice himself; Childe hides his resolve behind a joke, tears off his Fatui insignia, and chooses her openly. A Fatui guard enters to cover the Agent's retreat. Once the Agent has passed through the rear doorway, Childe and Lumine fight the guard in separate exchanges and subdue him together.
episode_summaries.cliffhanger: From the Golden House corridor, the Agent reveals: 'The port is already sealed. She can't leave.'
episode_summaries.notes: Produced with the run-local experimental stateful-scenes-v1 profile: adaptive 4-8 second scene lengths, sequential previous-video handoffs, a dedicated element-entry clip before interaction, a separate visible Agent-exit beat, and shot-scoped actor-target combat. The profile remains experimental and has not been copied into production_rules pending a separate user review. The final uses the canonical five-second animated Genshin CTA video.

episode_summaries.cliffhanger: Childe raises only his eyes toward Lumine and says: 'I said don't follow.'
episode_summaries.notes: Produced with the run-local dramatic-panels-v1 profile after the stateful frame-to-frame version was rejected in review. Six independent scene tableaux carry one clear plot beat each; action happens primarily between cuts, with minimal within-shot motion. Scene 1 is a fixed dialogue panel, scenes 2-5 are silent action panels, and scene 6 is the spoken cliffhanger. The approach remains run-local pending review of audience performance and is not yet a standing production rule. The canonical music and five-second Genshin CTA were reused.

production_rules: SWITCHED 2026-07-07 (from Room 1701 precedent): all 'Don't Save Me' clips are Kling I2V, including dialogue. Do not use Kling Avatar v2 and do not call fal-ai/kling-video/ai-avatar/*. EP1-3 used Kling Avatar v2 + Chatterbox TTS (see episode_summaries notes) — that mechanism is now retired for this series; EP4+ use Kling native voice cloning instead.

Dialogue scenes use Kling I2V multi_prompt + voice_ids + generate_audio:true. Reusable voices: Childe, Lumine, Agent (voice_id_kling per character below). Each Kling request uses at most 2 voice_ids and maps them locally to <<<voice_1>>>/<<<voice_2>>>; split 3-speaker exchanges (e.g. Agent+Childe+Lumine together) into multiple clips.

USER OVERRIDE — macro movement IS ALLOWED for this series, unlike the default serial-drama micro-motion-only rule. 'Don't Save Me' is a combat/thriller drama (blade strikes, gunfire, running, chases) — action_description and multi_prompt shots MAY describe literal combat/running/hits directly. Still respect Kling's own physical plausibility limits (no more coherent than a 3-5s continuous shot can sell) and still cut between clips for anything a single continuous I2V motion can't carry believably.

Dialogue I2V target length 6-10s, matching Room 1701 convention, but pacing follows this series' dramatic tension (slower/heavier than sitcom timing) rather than a fixed words/sec default — read each scene's emotional weight.

Attach character refs (character-sheet + location ref) to every scene image generation. Every visible or speaking character must be included in scene image_urls with their locked ref. Missing ref = stop before Animator.

Do not rely on character names in NB2/Kling prompts. Use the character's `prompt_descriptor` field verbatim in every scene image_prompt and immediately before each <<<voice_N>>> tag in multi_prompt — battle-tested pattern from Room 1701 EP1-3.
For dialogue I2V, voice_ids order, <<<voice_N>>> tags, speaker names, and physical descriptors must all point to the same character.
Any spoken line inside a dialogue I2V clip must have generate_audio:true, voice_ids, and <<<voice_N>>>; do not accidentally make a dialogue beat silent.
If a required story beat does not fit the 2-voice or 512-character shot limits, split/add a clip instead of dropping the beat.
Always generate background music with MiniMax Music (dramatic/tense mood, not comedic); never skip it or substitute a local library track.
